maddeler.e:
أكتئب (form VIII)
# أَكْتَئِبُ (ʔaktaʔibu) /ʔak.ta.ʔi.bu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِكْتَأَبَ (iktaʔaba)
# أَكْتَئِبَ (ʔaktaʔiba) /ʔak.ta.ʔi.ba/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِكْتَأَبَ (iktaʔaba)
# أَكْتَئِبْ (ʔaktaʔib) /ʔak.ta.ʔib/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِكْتَأَبَ (iktaʔaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
